comparison.objective: Move a wafer cassette through lift-off, IPA, and DI baths while catching and disposing of drips; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1152 tests cassette handling, bath sequencing, continuous drip-dish support, and controlled pouring; the candidate tests precision two-tool seating, countertorque, and articulated cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1152 grades bath order and dwell, wet handling, contamination avoidance, final DI placement, waste transfer, and release; the candidate grades retained angle and mechanical function.
comparison.reason: Wet-bench process handling and contamination control do not test threaded stop calibration.
